description: This Java class is a save handler for the ConceptName object in the OpenMRS project. It automatically processes ConceptName instances during save operations, specifically handling their associated tags by ensuring missing tag IDs are populated from the database.

classes.name: ConceptNameSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages the saving process of ConceptName objects, specifically updating tags missing IDs by fetching them from the database.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Ensures that all ConceptNameTags associated with a ConceptName have valid IDs by retrieving missing ones from the database.
